license_count.rationale: It could be a potential legal issue. Write a policy on it if so.

subscription_tier.description: Subscription tier information for the license config.
subscription_tier.rationale: Cost/Risk Management: Ensures the correct service tier is used, preventing either over-spending or using a lower tier that might lack necessary enterprise security features.

start_date.description: Its the start of the licence
start_date.rationale: It affects when you can start working. Write a policy.

subscription_term.description: The term you have the subscription active for
subscription_term.rationale: How long you can use the service before you lose access or break TOS. Write a policy.

auto_renew.description: Whether the license config should be auto renewed when it reaches the end date.
auto_renew.rationale: this attribute controls whether the license will automatically renew at the end date: While not a direct data security attribute, it's critical financial security/governance control.

end_date.description: Its the End Date of the licence.
end_date.rationale: Its the end date before you lose the licence and break TOS or lose acess. Write a policy.

free_trial.description: Whether the license config is for free trial.
free_trial.rationale: If you run out of free trial, you could end up paying money or losing work. Write a policy

location.description: The geographic location where the data store should reside. The value can only be one of "global", "us" and "eu".

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
